A '''battle''' took place near [[Ekuda]] in the [[Ekuda system/Legends|Ekuda system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Tano]]''.<ref name="XWvTF" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Ekuda appeared in a simulator mission in the video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''. The game specified that simulator missions were simulations of historical battles.<ref name="XWvTF" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Simulator appearance only}}
